program.name: Active Range
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Flexibility you can use: strength at the end of the range, then a stretch.
program.about: Flexibility you can use, not just reach. Each day starts with a circuit of strength at the end of the range, Cossack squats, Copenhagen planks and standing knee holds one day, Y raises, wall slides and Y-T-Ws the other, then a stretch for the same area. Strength there is what makes new range stay. Level II makes every hold longer and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Hip range circuit & stretch / shoulder range circuit & stretch
